import React from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { format } from 'date-fns'; const EventCard = ({ event }) => { const eventDate = new Date(event.date); const isUpcoming = eventDate > new Date(); return (
🎉

{event.name}

{isUpcoming ? 'Upcoming' : 'Past'}

{event.description}

👤 {event.organizer}
📍 {event.location}
📅 {format(eventDate, 'PPP')} at {format(eventDate, 'p')}
🎫 {event.availableSeats} / {event.capacity} seats available
🏷️ {event.category}
View Details
); }; export default EventCard;
